what: Gate 1 R1 mandated control: the API 26-30 software fallback run on a REAL API 26 system image, not only via the forced test entry points on a modern emulator.

measured.reason: KeyProperties.PURPOSE_AGREE_KEY requires API 31; this device is API 26. No Keystore-backed key agreement is possible.

note: This is the run the forced entry points CANNOT substitute for: on API 36 the backend is ANDROID_KEYSTORE and the absence of PURPOSE_AGREE_KEY below 31 is unobservable. Here backend() genuinely selects SOFTWARE_WRAPPED and E2eKeyStore.capability() reports UNSUPPORTED with the API-level reason, so the fallback is exercised as the ONLY available path. The android gate's own `api26ImageRun` count stays false because the gate drives a single attached device; this file is the separate evidence. Reproduce with tools/run-agreement-test.ps1 against a booted e2e_api26 AVD.
